BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to transporting unregistered snowmobiles; andamending RCW 46.10.020.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.10.020 and 1982 c 17 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except as provided in this chapter, no person shall own((,transport,)) or operate any snowmobile within this state unless suchsnowmobile has been registered in accordance with the provisions ofthis chapter. (2) A registration number shall be assigned, without payment of afee, to snowmobiles owned by the state of Washington or its politicalsubdivisions, and the assigned registration number shall be displayedupon each snowmobile in such manner as provided by rules adopted by thedepartment.
